grounding_rule: Every drafted sentence must point at the reviewed requirement it answers and the approved content it draws on. A section with no such anchor is not written; it is raised as a gap for a human to close.
export_note: An export is a package a person assembled and approved. Nothing leaves BidFusion because a stage finished.

stages.name: Customer context
stages.purpose: Assemble what the organization already knows about this account before anyone writes a word: prior bids, agreements in place, and recorded history.
stages.human_step: A bid manager confirms the context is the right account and the right opportunity before it informs anything downstream.

stages.name: Win strategy
stages.purpose: Turn evaluation criteria, customer priorities, and the competitive picture into themes a reviewer can agree or disagree with.
stages.human_step: A capture lead approves each theme, or sends it back with the proof point it is missing.

stages.name: Response blueprint
stages.purpose: Lay out the response against the reviewed requirements, so every mandatory item has a place before drafting starts.
stages.human_step: A bid manager confirms the structure matches what the tender actually asked for.

stages.name: Response draft
stages.purpose: Draft sections that cite the requirement they answer and the approved content they reuse.
stages.human_step: Every drafted section is written for review. None of it is customer-facing until an author has taken ownership of it.

stages.name: Quality review
stages.purpose: Check coverage against the requirement list and surface what is thin, missing, or unsupported.
stages.human_step: A reviewer decides what a finding means. A score never gates a submission on its own.

stages.name: Approval
stages.purpose: Record who approved what, on which version, and on what basis.
stages.human_step: Approval is the human act. There is no automatic path past this stage.

stages.name: Export package
stages.purpose: Assemble the approved response in the formats and naming the tender demands.
stages.human_step: A person exports, checks, and submits. BidFusion never submits anything.
